## WireDoubleSchema variable

Schema for a double control record, `{ "double": <payload> }`<!-- -->.

**Signature:**

```typescript
WireDoubleSchema: z.ZodType<WireDouble>
```

## Remarks

The payload is a finite JSON number or one of the special states `"NaN"`<!-- -->, `"Infinity"`<!-- -->, `"-Infinity"`<!-- -->, and `"-0"`<!-- -->. A non-finite number (such as an overflowing literal that parses to `Infinity`<!-- -->) is rejected rather than rounded. A JSON `-0` number is accepted, although encoders always emit the `"-0"` state.
